scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 24 boards from four live T7 benchmark games of 2026-11-25 (Immortal-Deity 6p, Online) whose trade capacity stood at one through turn 100 with 7-10 cities (civvis-t7-20261125T141505Z Byzantium Religion, -T153358Z Mali Religion, -T070805Z Khmer Science, -T143044Z Rome Science), every tenth turn from t50 to t100, each the run's events.jsonl cut after turn N+1 and replayed at turn N. Both arms run one frozen ci-profile civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch with the run's own requested genome (why.log line 1 forced); the on arm adds --with trade-district-before-the-library. 24 of 24 boards completed in both arms; orders differ on 3: Rome t50 (Ostia's Commercial Hub replaces Walls as its order) and t80 (Cumae claims its Harbor), Mali t100 (Kirina claims its Suguba). The on arms journal 3 'trade-district-before-the-library:' lines, the off arms 0. The t80 and t100 claims lose the queue later in the same frame to a sea-scout Quadrireme. In the Byzantine game every city had spent both district slots on a Holy Site and a Hippodrome by t90, so there was no slot to claim; the Khmer boards had no claimable calm city with a free slot within 20 turns.
